subject: QwikBundle marketplace launch — GCP/Azure co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Lena Kozlov <lena@qwikbundle.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.example.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.example.com>
Cc: rajesh@stratifycloud.com
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QwikBundle marketplace onboarding & quickstart packaging

Hi Maya / Ben / Olga,

Thanks again for taking time to chat today. QwikBundle is ready to move our quickstart connector into GCP Marketplace and we want Redwood listed as the preferred inference partner for the co-sell bundle (GCP + Azure targeting enterprise analytics customers).

High-level asks: 
- Review the attached marketplace checklist and confirm any Redwood-specific evidence (SaaS endpoint, license text, telemetry controls).
- Confirm the recommended SKU mapping for inference units so the GCP listing can show co-sell pricing guidance.
- Identify a technical owner at Redwood who can validate the quickstart container and run the pre-prod listing test.

Attachments: QwikBundle-MP-Checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB), launch-architecture-diagram.png (png, 210KB)

Proposed timeline: initial validation by Nov 23, listing submission by Nov 30, pilot co-sell outreach starting Dec 10.

Quick context: our quickstart spins up a lightweight connector + prebuilt inference image that calls Redwood’s hosted API. We’ll provide a test account and sample traffic.

Would love a short sync later today or tomorrow to align owners.

Best,
Lena Kozlov
Head of Partnerships, QwikBundle
Lena@qwikbundle.ai

Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QwikBundle marketplace onboarding & quickstart packaging

Thanks Maya / Lena — I took a pass on the checklist. Notes below (high-level):

- Auth & test accounts: We can provide a staging API key and a short-lived test org. No infra changes required for standard REST flows.
- Container validation: QwikBundle’s quickstart image must set the Greenwood-Client header and support KV cache sizing < 2GB for our demo SKU. I’ve added a short script (see checklist tab "validation-scripts") that runs a smoke generate/latency sweep.
- Telemetry & logs: We need a minimal set of fields in the request payload for trace correlation (trace_id, tenant_id). That’s documented in the attached checklist.
- Sequence length / batch sizing: Recommend capping demo runs at 512 tokens to remain within the validation profile.

Action items for me:
1) Run QwikBundle quickstart in our staging cluster (target Nov 22).
2) Share validation run logs and perf numbers (p50/p95) by EOD Nov 22.

Attachments referenced in checklist: validation-scripts.sh (script stub), QwikBundle-MP-Checklist.xlsx

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.example.com

Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QwikBundle marketplace onboarding & quickstart packaging

Thanks team — quick commercial note before we get too deep technically.

- For co-sell listings we typically surface a partner SKU that maps to an inference unit band (e.g., SB-100 / SB-500). Karthik, can you propose the labels and default price tier? We should keep the demo SKU conservative (SB-100).
- Revenue share: Vivek / Partnerships, do we want a 20% referral credit for the pilot period or a fixed marketing credit?
- Marketplace entitlements: QwikBundle will need a short statement from Redwood confirming supported regions, data residency, and allowed telemetry. I’ll draft the language and share.

Lena — please confirm if QwikBundle expects a co-marketing credit or direct lead credits for the first 3 customer introductions. That will determine how we set the partner incentive in the listing.

I’ll loop in legal once we have agreed economics for a short review of the partner addendum.

Olga Petrov
Head of Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.example.com

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QwikBundle marketplace onboarding & quickstart packaging

Appreciate the thoughtful notes. Quick executive steer:

- Prioritize getting a validated staging run and perf numbers — if Ben can deliver p50/p95 by Nov 22 we’ll greenlight the co-sell SKU labeling and marketing credit.
- For the pilot, Redwood will offer a 15% referral credit (versus 20%) and a $10k co-marketing fund that we can use for joint webinars / one-pager creation. Olga — please draft the partner wording and propose the SKU labels; Karthik — please prepare the pricing bands (SB-100 / SB-500) with uplift assumptions.
- Maya — please coordinate the marketplace submission packet and make sure the GCP listing has the Redwood partner logo.

We’ll treat this as a priority partner pilot — if validation looks good we’ll fast-track the marketplace approval and co-sell enablement. Final artifacts for listing (signed addendum, SKU mapping, validation logs) should be in the shared Drive folder by Nov 23 COB.

-Vivek
